timing.secondary_metric: host run_kernel + stream completion elapsed; never substituted for device duration

score.aggregate: arithmetic mean across all 15 public performance shapes
score.correctness_gate: all cases in declared correctness suite pass
score.reference: frozen 6368f40c source recompiled and measured under this exact protocol; not theoretical optimum
